------------------------CRM_CORPORATE---------------------------------

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(float,COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME)),0)  AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS)),0)  CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),OTHERLIMITS)),0)  OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOTALFUNDBASE)),0)  TOTALFUNDBASE_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(NUMERIC(25,5),TOTALNONFUNDBASE)),0)  TOTALNONFUNDBASE_tgt


, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME  AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS  CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, OTHERLIMITS  OTHERLIMITS_src
, TOTALFUNDBASE  TOTALFUNDBASE_src
, TOTALNONFUNDBASE  TOTALNONFUNDBASE_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CORPORATE WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_tgt
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, TOTALFUNDBASE_tgt
, TOTALNONFUNDBASE_tgt
, AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, OTHERLIMITS_src
, TOTALFUNDBASE_src
, TOTALNONFUNDBASE_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)


INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT
 CAST(COUNT_SRC  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC 
,CAST(COUNT_TGT  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT 
,CAST(AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_tgt 
,CAST(CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt 
,CAST(OTHERLIMITS_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OTHERLIMITS_tgt 
,CAST(TOTALFUNDBASE_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALFUNDBASE_tgt 
,CAST(TOTALNONFUNDBASE_tgt  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALNONFUNDBASE_tgt 
,CAST(AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_src 
,CAST(CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src 
,CAST(OTHERLIMITS_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) OTHERLIMITS_src 
,CAST(TOTALFUNDBASE_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALFUNDBASE_src 
,CAST(TOTALNONFUNDBASE_src  AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TOTALNONFUNDBASE_src 
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,DATE
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_src
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_src
, OTHERLIMITS_src
, TOTALFUNDBASE_src
, TOTALNONFUNDBASE_src
)
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, AVERAGE_ANNUALINCOME_tgt
, CUSTDEPOSITSINOTHERBANKS_tgt
, OTHERLIMITS_tgt
, TOTALFUNDBASE_tgt
, TOTALNONFUNDBASE_tgt
)
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
